description: Read one saved client review version with its original snapshot and version identity. Version IDs must belong to this review. Reading history never fetches today’s website.

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

reviewId.description: Client review UUID; not the public link token

name: get_client_review_version
